instruction: From now on, whenever you put a pen in my pen case, turn the pen so that it lines up with the long side of the case before you lower it. Please put the yellow pen in the green pen case now.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use the first grasp candidate
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]  # Align pen with case's long axis
carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")

goals.evidence: Please put the yellow pen in the green pen case now.

constraints: The yellow pen must be oriented so that it lines up with the long side of the green pen case before being lowered.
The green pen case must be empty or cleared of any obstructing objects before placing the pen.
The robot must verify the orientation of the pen relative to the long side of the case before lowering it.
task_spec.refined_instruction: The robot must first ensure the green pen case is empty. Then, pick up the yellow pen, rotate it so that it aligns with the long side of the green pen case, and carefully lower it into the case while maintaining this alignment. Success is confirmed when the yellow pen is fully inside the green pen case and oriented parallel to its long side, with no part of the pen extending beyond the case or obstructing its closure.
